files..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "name": "named-subagents-mod",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Gives every subagent a themed name in the task tree, and lists the running agents under those names in a side pane: what each is doing, its tokens, its conversation a press away.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Bobby-cell-commits"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Bobby-cell-commits/named-subagents-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Bobby-cell-commits/named-subagents-mod",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "subagents",
    "names",
    "fan-out",
    "pane",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name pool",
      "description": "auto picks the pool from the agent type and task; any other value always uses that pool.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "explore",
        "code",
        "research",
        "reflect",
        "debug",
        "test",
        "review",
        "security",
        "design",
        "data",
        "orchestrate",
        "docs",
        "build",
        "default"
      ]
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Name subagents",
      "description": "Turn naming off without uninstalling.",
      "default": true
    },
    "names": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Your names",
      "description": "Extra names for your agents, separated by commas: Ripley, Deckard. They get about half of the draws. Letters, digits, _ and - only. /names adds more later.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "only_custom": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use only my names",
      "description": "Leave out the built-in names and draw only from the ones you add.",
      "default": false
    },
    "pane": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the agents pane",
      "description": "Off, the mod only names agents: no pane, no count under the prompt, no finish toasts, no /roster.",
      "default": true
    },
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pane: open by itself",
      "description": "Open the agents pane when an agent starts. Off, /roster opens it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "foldAfter": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Pane: fold after (seconds)",
      "description": "Fold the pane this many seconds after the last agent finishes; 0 keeps it open.",
      "default": 10
    },
    "motion": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pane: motion",
      "description": "Animate the spinner on running agents.",
      "default": true
    },
    "toasts": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pane: finish toasts",
      "description": "A toast when agents finish.",
      "default": true
    },
    "keepFinished": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Pane: finished agents listed",
      "description": "How many finished agents the list keeps (1-30).",
      "default": 8
    },
    "statusLine": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pane: status line",
      "description": "Count the running agents under the prompt while the pane is not on screen.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
